memories.content: First-time visitors expect to be able to receive immediate directions to their destination at the visitor services desk on the first floor.

Provide guidance after checking both the published floor-by-floor facilities and temporary operation notices.
Do not infer the scope of nonpublic construction.
Do not infer the results of on-site inspections.
Cleaning and security contractor staff prefer service routes separated from general users during shift changes.
The main entrance lobby is on the first floor of the Main Building.
The visitor services desk is on the first floor of the Main Building.
The Innovation Hub is on the first floor of the Main Building.
A general restroom is on the first floor of the Main Building.
An accessible restroom is on the first floor of the Main Building.
The elevator lobby on the second floor of the Main Building is near the student support administration office.
The elevator lobby on the third floor of the Main Building is near the corridor toward the Central Library.
The names of the department offices on the fourth floor of the Main Building are displayed on the floor directory.
A shared printing station available to students is on the fourth floor of the Main Building.
The research labs on the fifth floor of the Main Building are not spaces open to the general public.
The collaborative research lab on the sixth floor of the Main Building is used by authorized research members.
Consultations with the research support office on the seventh floor of the Main Building follow the posted appointment process.
Visitors to staff offices on the eighth floor of the Main Building expect the staff member with whom they have an appointment to be in the office at the scheduled time.
Public administrative services on the ninth floor of the Main Building are provided during each department's operating hours.
The elevators in the Main Building connect the underground parking level through the tenth floor.
The floor directory agent can describe the floors and space names of published facilities.
The floor directory agent cannot check the current occupancy status of meeting rooms.
First-time visitors are more familiar with department names than floor numbers and can more easily understand directions centered on department names.
On public holidays, some administrative offices may not operate even when the Main Building is open.
The floor directory agent cannot verify in real time, at the time of an inquiry, whether published floor-by-floor information matches the actual layout.
Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: The ATM on the first floor of the Main Building is closed during the construction period.
Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: The 24-hour unattended store on the first floor of the Main Building is closed during the construction period.
Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, direct users of the Main Building ATM to the ATM on the first floor of the West Complex.
Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, direct users of the Main Building's 24-hour store to the Campus Store in the Engineering Building between 7:00 a.m. and 11:00 p.m.
Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: Explain that after 11:00 p.m. there is no alternative on-campus store to replace the 24-hour unattended store in the Main Building.
Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: The Campus Store on the first floor of the Main Building is closed during the construction period.
Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, the Campus Store in the Engineering Building operates from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: The cafe on the first floor of the Main Building does not operate during the construction period.
Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the cafe closure, instruct only staff to use the coffee machine inside the first-floor Innovation Hub.

Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: A student who used the Main Building ATM in the evening may expect to be able to withdraw cash at the same location during the construction period, come to the Main Building, and then have to find the West Complex ATM.

Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, the amenities guidance agent may exclude the closed Main Building ATM, unattended store, Campus Store, and cafe from recommendations and provide guidance only to posted alternative facilities.

Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, the route for ATM use changes from the first floor of the Main Building to the first floor of the West Complex without passing through the Main Building construction zone.

Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: The concessionaire operating the Campus Store in the Engineering Building may expect more alternative users because of the closure of Main Building facilities and seek to increase evening staffing and inventory above normal levels during the construction period.

analysis.overview: The frames largely complement rather than contradict each other: the reference provides building locations, access limits, and directory practices, while the compared frame adds construction-period amenity closures, alternatives, routing, and operational impacts. Their shared guidance principle is to honor temporary notices and posted alternatives.

relations.reason: Both memories govern how current guidance should combine published information with temporary notices and remain consistent without requiring a further scope distinction.
relations.summary: Facility guidance should incorporate temporary operations information, exclude closed amenities, and direct users only to posted alternatives.
